name: How do I choose the right ADU contractor in Los Angeles and avoid getting burned?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right ADU contractor in Los Angeles and avoid getting burned?

acceptedAnswer.text:
Choosing the right contractor is arguably the most important ADU decision; you want someone experienced with ADUs and your local jurisdiction, not just the lowest bidder. Look for a track record of finished ADUs, clear communication, and detailed written contracts. 

The cheapest estimate up front often becomes the most expensive once delays, change orders, and quality issues are factored in.

Key factors:
- Number of ADUs completed in the last few years locally
- Recent references you can actually call or visit
- Detailed scope, schedule, and payment milestones in writing
- Licensing, insurance, and responsiveness to questions

Interview at least two or three ADU-focused contractors, ask to see completed projects, and compare not just price but clarity of scope and process. The team that explains things clearly and transparently is usually the one you’ll want to build with.
acceptedAnswer.description: Pick an ADU contractor based on recent local ADU experience, solid references, and a detailed written scope—not the lowest price alone. Verify licensing and insurance, review a clear schedule and payment plan, and favor the team that explains permits, inspections, and risks openly.
